 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026: Hall Ticket release date, how to download and required documents AIBE 22 admit cards release on November 14, 2026.
 The exam is scheduled to take place on November 29, 2026.
 Candidates must carry a printed hall ticket and valid ID.

 The AIBE 22 admit card 2026 is expected to be available soon on the official website of the Bar Council of India (BCI). Candidates appearing for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) 22 will be able to download their hall tickets online using their login credentials once the download link is activated. 
 The admit card is an essential document for the examination and will contain details such as the candidate’s name, roll number, examination centre, reporting time and other important instructions. Candidates must download and print their hall tickets before the examination day, as the document will not be sent through offline mode. 
 According to the examination schedule, the AIBE 22 admit card is scheduled for release on November 14, 2026, while the examination will be conducted on November 29, 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official portal regularly for updates. 
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026: Important Dates 
 Candidates preparing for the All India Bar Examination 22 should keep the following dates in mind. 
 Event Date 
 AIBE 22 Admit Card Release Date November 14, 2026 
 AIBE 22 Examination Date November 29, 2026 
 Admit Card Download Mode Online 
 Examination Mode Offline (OMR-based) 
 Official Website allindiabarexamination.com 
 Candidates should note that the admit card download link will be accessible only after the BCI activates it on the official website. 
 How to Download AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 
 Once the Bar Council of India releases the AIBE 22 hall ticket, candidates can follow these steps to download it: 
 Visit the official website, allindiabarexamination.com . 
 Look for the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 link on the homepage. 
 Click on the admit card download link. 
 Enter your AIBE login ID and password. 
 Click on the Submit button. 
 The AIBE 22 hall ticket will appear on the screen. 
 Verify all the details mentioned on the document. 
 Download the admit card and save it. 
 Take a clear printout to carry to the examination centre. 
 Candidates should ensure that the printed copy is legible and that all details are correctly displayed. 
 AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026 Direct Link 
 The direct link to download the AIBE 22 admit card will be available on the official examination portal once the BCI activates the facility. 
 Direct link: allindiabarexamination.com allindiabarexamination.com 
 Candidates should avoid downloading hall tickets from unofficial websites and use the BCI’s official portal for all examination-related updates. 
 Documents to Carry Along With AIBE Admit Card 2026 
 Candidates appearing for AIBE 22 must carry a printed copy of their admit card along with a valid photo identity document for verification at the examination centre.  The identity documents mentioned for the examination include: 
 Aadhaar Card 
 Voter ID Card 
 Passport 
 Driving Licence 
 Enrollment Slip 
 Advocate Enrollment ID issued by the State Bar Council, if available 
 Candidates should check the instructions printed on their admit cards to confirm the documents required at their allotted examination centre.  The AIBE 22 examination will be held in offline mode. Candidates will be required to mark their answers on the OMR sheets provided at the centre. 
 What to do if there is an error in the AIBE 22 admit card? 
 Candidates must carefully check their AIBE 22 hall tickets after downloading them. Any discrepancy in the candidate’s name, enrollment details, examination centre or other information should be reported to the examination authorities immediately. 
 If candidates find an error, they can contact the Examination Controller of the Bar Council of India through email at:  aibe.helpdesk@gmail.com 
 The email should clearly describe the error and include scanned copies of relevant documents supporting the requested correction.  Candidates should not delay reporting discrepancies, as incorrect information on the admit card may cause difficulties during examination-day verification. 
 Can Candidates Edit Details on the AIBE 22 Admit Card 2026? 
 No. Candidates cannot make changes to the details printed on the AIBE 22 admit card themselves.  If any information is incorrect, they must contact the Bar Council of India through the prescribed email process and submit the necessary supporting documents. The correction, if approved, will be handled by the examination authorities. 
 AIBE 22 Exam 2026: Important instructions for candidates 
 Candidates appearing for the All India Bar Examination 22 should keep the following instructions in mind: 
 Download the admit card as soon as the link becomes available. 
 Carry a printed copy of the hall ticket to the examination centre. 
 Bring a valid government-issued photo ID for identity verification. 
 Check the examination centre address and reporting time carefully. 
 Reach the allotted venue before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card. 
 Read all examination instructions printed on the hall ticket. 
 Follow the rules prescribed by the Bar Council of India during the examination. 
 The AIBE 22 examination is scheduled for November 29, 2026. Candidates should keep checking the official website for the latest updates regarding the admit card, examination guidelines and other important announcements.
